name: Provider Inflight Limit Plan
description: Add a provider-connection level API-server cap for Prompts in Progress so Forska can limit concurrency per provider, including Codex, independently of runtime or sbatch settings.

userStories.title: Add provider connection inflight limit storage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want provider connections to store a nullable max inflight limit so Forska can persist scheduler-owned concurrency caps separately from provider metadata or runtime state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration for `app.provider_connection.max_inflight_requests` as a nullable column.
Thread `maxInflightRequests` through provider connection row, record, repository, and route payload types.
Existing provider connections continue to behave the same when the column is `NULL`.

userStories.title: Persist and validate provider inflight limits via API
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want provider create and update routes to accept a nullable positive inflight limit so the saved scheduler cap can be managed through the provider API.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/provider-connections` and `PATCH /api/provider-connections/:id` accept `maxInflightRequests` as `NULL` or a positive integer.
The API rejects `0`, negative values, and non-integers with actionable validation errors.
Provider connection responses round-trip the saved `maxInflightRequests` value.

userStories.title: Show the inflight limit in the Providers UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit a provider connection's Prompts in Progress limit from the Providers page so I can control Forska's API-server concurrency without touching runtime launch settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a `Prompts in Progress limit` input to `src/app/routes/+providers/+$id/+index.tsx` for editable provider connections, including Codex App.
UI copy explains that an empty value uses the provider-family default, with Codex falling back to `CODEX_MAX_INFLIGHT` and runtime-backed providers falling back to current runtime or global capacity.
Saving and reloading the provider page preserves the configured or cleared value.

Browser verify in `/providers/:id`: save a provider cap, leave it empty for default, confirm the saved value survives reload, verify a capped provider does not let `Prompts in Progress` exceed the configured value, and verify Codex uses the same field with its own default fallback

userStories.title: Thread provider cap data into running job capacity logic
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want running judgment job capacity planning to know each job's provider connection and saved inflight cap so prompt scheduling can group work by provider connection.
acceptanceCriteria: Running-job lookup includes `providerConnectionId` and the saved `maxInflightRequests` value needed for scheduling.
Add a helper that computes an effective provider cap from the saved provider value and the provider-family default behavior.
Leaving `maxInflightRequests` empty preserves today's capacity behavior for both Codex and non-Codex providers.

userStories.title: Cap prompt claiming per provider connection
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt claiming to respect provider-level inflight caps so multiple jobs sharing one provider connection cannot over-claim Prompts in Progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Group running jobs by provider connection when computing prompt claim budgets in `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM.ts`.
Jobs sharing one provider connection cannot collectively claim beyond that provider's effective cap.
Different provider connections can still make progress independently while staying under stricter global limits.

userStories.title: Enforce provider caps in request-slot scheduling
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the request runtime to enforce provider-scoped inflight caps so worker-based and fallback requests cannot exceed the configured provider budget after prompts have been claimed.
acceptanceCriteria: Pass provider connection identity and effective provider cap into `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsRequestRuntime.ts`.
Maintain provider-scoped in-flight accounting for worker-based and fallback requests, with counts releasing correctly on success and failure.
Provider caps compose correctly with worker load balancing and circuit breaking instead of bypassing them.

userStories.title: Apply the same provider cap setting to Codex
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Codex App to use the same saved provider inflight setting so Forska has one provider-level concurrency control with a Codex-specific default fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: The Codex provider connection uses the same saved `maxInflightRequests` field as other providers.
When the Codex field is empty, scheduling falls back to `CODEX_MAX_INFLIGHT`; when it is set, the saved value governs Codex prompt claiming and request-slot concurrency.
Codex behavior remains isolated from non-Codex provider defaults while still using the shared provider-level setting.
